The administration of loop diuretics, pre-existing renal impairment, or volume depletion can lead to increased aminoglycoside concentrations within the nephron, heightening the risk of nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Close monitoring and therapy modification are recommended. Avoid concurrent or sequential use to minimize ototoxicity risk. 2.
